message.content:
**Moderna, Inc. (CIK 1682852) — business segments and the most important business**

**Accounting reportable segments: only one.** Moderna states that it "operates as a single operating and reportable segment," reflecting an integrated business focused on research, development and commercialization of mRNA-based medicines. The CEO is the Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM), who reviews financial information on a consolidated basis; no program- or function-level profit information is regularly provided to the CODM. This disclosure appears in the FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2025-02-21), "Segment Information" note (chunk 1682852/mrna-20241231:496000). The FY2023 10-K said the same: "we have concluded that we operate as one segment" (chunk 1682852/mrna-20231231:507200). The structured data are consistent — the only segment-related tag is `NumberOfOperatingSegments`.

**Business franchises (not reportable segments).** Management describes its mRNA platform as addressing four franchises: respiratory virus vaccines, latent and other virus vaccines, oncology therapeutics, and rare disease therapeutics (FY2024 10-K, chunk 1682852/mrna-20241231:19200). These are business/portfolio classifications, not accounting segments, and no franchise-level revenue or profit is disclosed.

**Which is most important today: the COVID vaccine (Spikevax).** By revenue, it is overwhelmingly dominant. Net product sales by product for the year ended December 31, 2024 were:

| Product | 2024 | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|---|
| COVID | $3,084M | $6,671M | $18,435M |
| RSV (mRESVIA) | $25M | — | — |
| Total net product sales | $3,109M | $6,671M | $18,435M |

(FY2024 10-K, "Net Product Sales" note, chunk 1682852/mrna-20241231:537600.)

COVID was therefore about 99% of 2024 net product sales ($3,084M of $3,109M), and RSV — approved by the FDA in May 2024, with sales starting Q3 2024 — contributed only $25M. Total revenue was $3,236M in 2024 versus $6,848M in 2023 (fact IDs 2606798 and 2606789, accession 0001682852-25-000022), so net product sales were the bulk of total revenue, with the remainder being "other revenue" (grants and collaboration revenue).

**Caveats.** (1) The COVID share above is a simple ratio of disclosed figures, not a separately reported metric. (2) COVID revenue fell 53% in 2024 as the market shifted from pandemic to endemic/seasonal and as European and rest-of-world advance purchase agreements wound down (chunk 1682852/mrna-20241231:444800), so the concentration is declining. (3) The pipeline franchises (oncology INT with Merck, flu/combination vaccines, rare disease) generate no product revenue yet, so their "importance" is strategic rather than financial.
